01 ACT I · THE STRUGGLE

THE 9:00 AM WHITEBOARD BOTTLENECK

Picture a busy dispatch desk on a Monday morning. New quote requests are pouring in, drivers are already out on Nairobi roads, and the only map of who is carrying what is written in dry-erase marker on an office whiteboard. Whenever a client called to ask if their order had left yet, customer service had to pause, call or text the driver in traffic, wait for a reply, and call the customer back. Double-bookings slipped through and paper delivery slips vanished.

02 ACT II · THE TURNING POINT

ENGINEERING ONE CONNECTED PULSE

Instead of handing them another rigid spreadsheet, we sat down with their dispatchers and mapped the real life of a single package. Together, we built a custom delivery platform powered by a real-time PostgreSQL state engine. Every order moves through four unmistakable stages — Pending Quote, Assigned, In Transit, and Delivered. The moment a driver taps their phone at a checkpoint, the dispatcher’s dashboard and the customer’s tracking link update in the same heartbeat.

03 ACT III · WHERE THEY ARE NOW

THE WHITEBOARD IS GONE

Today, the dispatch room is calm. Owners review quotes and dispatch jobs in a single click. Drivers see their exact manifest on their phones without endless phone calls, proof of delivery is captured digitally at the doorstep, and customers track their own deliveries online like a major courier.

01 STATE ENGINE

KILLING DOUBLE-BOOKINGS WITH ATOMIC DRIVER LOCKS

When two dispatchers answered phones at 9:00 AM, there was no single source of truth showing which truck was already committed. We modeled every delivery as a strict 4-stage PostgreSQL state machine with row-level FOR UPDATE NOWAIT locks so a truck can never be double-booked.

POSTGRESQL supabase/migrations/001_order_state_machine.sql 
CREATE TYPE delivery_stage AS ENUM (
  'pending_quote',
  'assigned',
  'in_transit',
  'delivered'
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION assign_driver_atomic(
  p_order_id UUID,
  p_driver_id UUID
) RETURNS orders AS $$
DECLARE
  v_order orders;
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM drivers
  WHERE id = p_driver_id AND status = 'available'
  FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;

  UPDATE drivers SET status = 'on_route' WHERE id = p_driver_id;

  UPDATE orders
  SET stage = 'assigned',
      driver_id = p_driver_id,
      assigned_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_order_id AND stage = 'pending_quote'
  RETURNING * INTO v_order;

  RETURN v_order;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
02 1-CLICK DISPATCH

INSTANT QUOTE-TO-MANIFEST BROADCAST

When a dispatcher clicks 'Approve & Assign', a single TypeScript controller executes the atomic PostgreSQL lock and immediately broadcasts the active manifest to the driver's cab and the customer's tracking link.

TYPESCRIPT src/services/dispatchEngine.ts 
export async function approveAndDispatchOrder(
  orderId: string,
  driverId: string
) {
  const { data: lockedOrder, error } = await supabase.rpc(
    "assign_driver_atomic",
    { p_order_id: orderId, p_driver_id: driverId }
  );

  if (error || !lockedOrder) {
    throw new Error("Driver is already assigned to an active route.");
  }

  await supabase.channel(`order:${orderId}`).send({
    type: "broadcast",
    event: "STAGE_LOCKED",
    payload: { stage: "assigned", driverId, timestamp: Date.now() },
  });

  return lockedOrder;
}

Customers can look up a delivery and follow its status. The screenshot shows the project’s tracking demo.

01 LIVE WEBSOCKET TRACKER

CUSTOMER DELIVERY STATUS AND TRACKING

Clients receive a unique tracking link (/track/[token]) that subscribes directly to PostgreSQL row updates over Supabase Realtime. When a driver updates a delivery, the tracking page can show its updated status.

REACT + SUPABASE REALTIME src/hooks/useLiveOrderTracker.ts 
export function useLiveOrderTracker(trackingToken: string) {
  const [order, setOrder] = useState<OrderRecord | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`tracker:${trackingToken}`)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        {
          event: "UPDATE",
          schema: "public",
          table: "orders",
          filter: `tracking_token=eq.${trackingToken}`,
        },
        (payload) => setOrder(payload.new as OrderRecord)
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => { void supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [trackingToken]);

  return order;
}
02 DIGITAL PROOF OF DELIVERY

DOORSTEP SIGNATURE & PHOTO LOCK BEFORE COMPLETION

Paper delivery slips used to vanish in truck cabs. Completing a delivery now requires a doorstep signature canvas or cargo photo upload, binding an immutable receipt URL to the order row before unlocking the 'delivered' state.

TYPESCRIPT src/driver/completeDeliveryWithPod.ts 
export async function completeDeliveryWithPod(
  orderId: string,
  signatureBlob: Blob,
  recipientName: string
) {
  const filePath = `pod/${orderId}_${Date.now()}.png`;
  const { error: uploadErr } = await supabase.storage
    .from("delivery-proofs")
    .upload(filePath, signatureBlob, { contentType: "image/png" });

  if (uploadErr) throw uploadErr;

  return supabase
    .from("orders")
    .update({
      stage: "delivered",
      pod_signature_path: filePath,
      received_by: recipientName,
      delivered_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", orderId);
}

01 ACT I · THE STRUGGLE

LOSING GOOD DRIVERS TO PAPERWORK FRICTION

In the American freight market, independent owner-operators and small fleet owners are constantly on the move. When they landed on Delivah’s old setup, they couldn’t immediately tell how dispatch rates, route planning, or broker negotiations worked. Worse, when a carrier wanted to sign up, the team had to manually chase W9 tax forms, MC authority letters, and insurance certificates across phone calls and broken email threads.

02 ACT II · THE TURNING POINT

A HIGH-TRUST FUNNEL & GUIDED CARRIER VAULT

We reimagined the entire journey from a driver’s cab. First, we crafted a bold landing experience that answers an owner-operator’s biggest questions upfront — rate advantages, dedicated dispatcher support, and zero-forced-dispatch clarity. Then we connected that front door directly to a guided registration portal that validates every required document (W9, MC/DOT authority, COI insurance) as the carrier uploads it.

01 FUNNEL & SCHEMA GUARDS

PRE-QUALIFYING CARRIERS & ENFORCING COMPLETE PACKETS

Drivers visiting from a truck stop need instant clarity on Dry Van, Reefer, and Flatbed dispatch economics. The Service Funnel passes their selected equipment directly into a typed 4-step onboarding wizard that blocks submission until the W-9, MC Authority Letter, and Certificate of Insurance are verified.

TYPESCRIPT src/schemas/carrierOnboardingSchema.ts 
export interface CarrierIntakePacket {
  legalBusinessName: string;
  mcNumber: `MC-${number}`;
  dotNumber: `DOT-${number}`;
  equipmentType: "53_dry_van" | "53_reefer" | "48_flatbed";
  preferredStates: string[];
  documents: {
    w9TaxFormUrl: string;
    mcAuthorityLetterUrl: string;
    certificateOfInsuranceUrl: string;
    noticeOfAssignmentUrl?: string;
  };
}

export function validateComplianceVault(docs: CarrierIntakePacket["documents"]) {
  const required = [
    ["W-9 Tax Form", docs.w9TaxFormUrl],
    ["MC Authority Letter", docs.mcAuthorityLetterUrl],
    ["Certificate of Insurance (COI)", docs.certificateOfInsuranceUrl],
  ] as const;

  const missing = required.filter(([, url]) => !url || !url.startsWith("https://"));
  if (missing.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(`Missing required documents: ${missing.map(([k]) => k).join(", ")}`);
  }
  return { verified: true, packetComplete: true };
}
02 COMPLIANCE VAULT STORAGE

CAB-FRIENDLY MOBILE DOCUMENT UPLOADS BY MC NUMBER

Owner-operators upload PDFs or phone camera scans straight from their cab. Each file is size-checked and stored under a deterministic folder keyed by the carrier's MC authority number.

TYPESCRIPT + SUPABASE STORAGE src/services/uploadCarrierDocument.ts 
export async function uploadCarrierDocument(
  mcNumber: string,
  docType: "w9" | "mc_authority" | "coi_insurance" | "noa",
  file: File
) {
  if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
    throw new Error("Document exceeds 15MB cab-upload limit.");
  }

  const cleanMc = mcNumber.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
  const storagePath = `carriers/MC-${cleanMc}/${docType}_${Date.now()}.pdf`;

  const { error } = await supabase.storage
    .from("carrier-compliance-vault")
    .upload(storagePath, file, { upsert: true });

  if (error) throw error;
  return supabase.storage.from("carrier-compliance-vault").getPublicUrl(storagePath).data.publicUrl;
}

Document uploads form part of the carrier registration record before staff review.

01 ATOMIC PACKET SUBMISSION

RELATIONAL CARRIER + VAULT BINDING WITH INSTANT ALERT

When the driver submits their packet, our API validates the vault, inserts the carrier profile and all document URLs in one atomic transaction, and fires an EmailJS notification straight to the dispatch desk.

NEXT.JS API + SUPABASE src/app/api/carriers/submit/route.ts 
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const packet: CarrierIntakePacket = await req.json();
  validateComplianceVault(packet.documents);

  const { data: carrier, error } = await supabase
    .from("carrier_applications")
    .insert({
      legal_name: packet.legalBusinessName,
      mc_number: packet.mcNumber,
      dot_number: packet.dotNumber,
      equipment_type: packet.equipmentType,
      w9_url: packet.documents.w9TaxFormUrl,
      mc_letter_url: packet.documents.mcAuthorityLetterUrl,
      coi_url: packet.documents.certificateOfInsuranceUrl,
      review_status: "pending_review",
    })
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });

  await emailjs.send(SERVICE_ID, DISPATCH_TEMPLATE_ID, {
    carrier_name: carrier.legal_name,
    mc_number: carrier.mc_number,
    equipment: carrier.equipment_type,
  });

  return Response.json({ status: "submitted", carrierId: carrier.id });
}
02 1-CLICK FLEET ACTIVATION

STAFF COMPLIANCE QUEUE & INSTANT APPROVAL

Dispatch staff inspect the W-9, MC Authority, and COI side by side and clear the carrier to haul in a single click — eliminating multi-day email back-and-forth.

TYPESCRIPT src/services/staffComplianceQueue.ts 
export async function approveCarrierCompliance(
  applicationId: string,
  reviewerId: string
) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("carrier_applications")
    .update({
      review_status: "cleared_to_haul",
      verified_by: reviewerId,
      verified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", applicationId)
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

02 GSAP SCROLL CHOREOGRAPHY

HARDWARE-ACCELERATED REVEALS WITH REDUCED-MOTION GUARDS

Using GSAP ScrollTrigger wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion media queries, each chapter reveals smoothly on both boardroom 4K screens and construction-site phones.

GSAP + REACT src/components/useOrchestratorReveal.ts 
export function useOrchestratorReveal(scopeRef: RefObject<HTMLElement>) {
  useGSAP(() => {
    const mm = gsap.matchMedia();
    mm.add("(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)", () => {
      gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>("[data-chapter-card]").forEach((card) => {
        gsap.fromTo(
          card,
          { autoAlpha: 0, y: 28 },
          {
            autoAlpha: 1,
            y: 0,
            duration: 0.65,
            ease: "power3.out",
            scrollTrigger: { trigger: card, start: "top 84%" },
          }
        );
      });
    });
    return () => mm.revert();
  }, { scope: scopeRef });
}

REACT + TYPESCRIPT src/components/CivilProjectLedger.tsx 
export function filterProjectsByDomain(
  projects: CivilCaseStudy[],
  domain: "ALL" | "EPS_SYSTEMS" | "STRUCTURAL_STEEL" | "GM_TURNAROUND"
) {
  if (domain === "ALL") return projects;
  return projects.filter((p) => p.domain === domain && p.safetyIncidents === 0);
}
